_README: (target ~1600px wide, WebP or JPEG, under ~300KB each)
2. Add an entry below. `alt` is required — it is read by screen readers
AND indexed by Google Image Search, which is real traffic for a venue.
3. Set the top-level "hero" object to feature one photo behind the
page headline. It is separate from the gallery list, so include it in
"gallery" too if you also want it clickable.
Until at least one photo is listed, the page falls back to the existing
storefront image and the gallery section hides itself entirely.
Fields: src (required), alt (required), caption (optional, shown under the
photo in the lightbox), wide (optional bool - makes the tile span two
columns for landscape shots you want to feature).
